the genetic and molecular epidemiology of human papilloma virus (HPV) infection and cervical cancer, the most frequent cancer in women worldwide.
the host genetic factors that may influence the immune response to the virus and thus indirectly increase the susceptibility for developing cervical cancer.
the genetic factors that influence susceptibility to cervical neoplasms.
